about.title: About & Privacy
about.developerDesc: Created by Rotana NOB (Rotana E-Learning) as a helpful tool to share with the community.
about.purposeDesc: Built to make scanning QR codes and barcodes fast, clear, easy to use, and privacy-focused on your device.
about.privacyDesc: This app runs entirely locally on your device (Offline). Your scans and history stay on your phone, with no data sent to external servers.
